description: He wears a long dark blue textured coat over a cream embroidered shirt. Broad gold woven borders decorate the coat front, cuffs and hem; a decorated brown belt with a round gold buckle and hanging strap gathers the waist. His sleeves reach the wrists and his hands hang naturally at his sides. Dark brown trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots. The entire standing figure and both feet are visible, with floor below them. His head is bare and no armor or weapon is present.
